Validates a hotkey and throws an error if invalid.
Useful for development-time validation.

## Parameters

### hotkey

[`ValidatableHotkey`](../type-aliases/ValidatableHotkey.md)

The hotkey string to validate

## Returns

`void`

## Throws

Error if the hotkey is invalid

## Example

